QuestInfo.0: The Legends Awards runs from 12/7/2011 to 1/31/2012! Talk to the Maple Administrator about it.
QuestInfo.1: The Maple Administrator congratulated you on becoming more powerful, and gave you Legends Awards Coins for your hard work. Keep leveling up, and get more coins by completing your 3rd and 4th Job Advancements by 1/31/2012.

0.0: Congratulations on your 2nd Job Advancement, #h0#! I am sure you're well aware of the Legends Awards, which runs from 12/7/2011 to 1/31/2012. Well, if you make your advancement in that time, I'll give you some bonus Legends Awards Coins!

1.0: More Legends Awards Coins are waiting for you when you complete your 3rd and 4th Job Advancements! Just get them done by 1/31/2012. Good luck!
